answer: An agent economy can gate voting and attestations behind a refundable stake, while slashing it when an identity signs conflicting histories or colludes with already-flagged peers. A newcomer enters through an inlet but gains weight only after consistent, cross-checked work over time. Creating Sybils then forces the attacker to divide stake among weak identities or lock additional capital in each; detection burns those deposits. The delta is a direct, measurable cost, unlike free accounts wandering through a meadow.
